description: The words and ids of the action gate, as DATA. do-work/decide-action.mjs names no verdict, behaviour, scope or sentence: it reads them here. `verdicts` are the three ways a decision ends. `behaviours` are what a policy rule may name in `then`: `verdict` is what it gives when its `when` holds, `checked_first` puts it before grants and every other rule (a refusal that cannot be talked around), `verdict_when_asked_for` is what it gives instead when the person asked for exactly this action. `default_verdict` is the verdict when no rule holds and the policy names no `otherwise`. `outcomes` are the verdicts the gate itself gives (policy paused, action declined earlier, matching grant). `when_nobody_can_ask` turns a final verdict into another when no one can be asked now. `scopes` are the grant scopes: `requires` lists the conditions a grant must meet (`unused`: not yet used; `same_thread`: made for the thread of the request) and `consumed_on_use` says the caller marks it used. `retry` is the guidance for each way a decision can end. `identity_fields` are the fields of an action that make up its identity when the request names none. `problems` are the sentences of the policy check; {rule}, {then} and {other} are filled with the rule ids and the behaviour named.

verdicts.says: The person has to be asked before this action runs.

scopes.matches: Only the first time, until the caller marks the grant used.
Every time in the thread the grant was made for.
Every time, until the grant expires.

retry.refused_by_rule: A rule of the policy refuses this action: do not retry it. The person changes the rule if they want it to run.
retry.declined: The person declined this action earlier: ask again only after the person has spoken since.
retry.cannot_ask: No one can be asked now: continue without this action. The person can do it themselves or give a grant for it.
retry.paused: The policy is paused: wait until the person resumes it.

declined_says: The person declined this action earlier.
grant_says: The person gave a grant for this action.

problems.unknown-behaviour: Rule {rule} names {then} in `then`, which is not one of: {other}.
problems.incomplete-when: Rule {rule} has a `when` the gate cannot fully evaluate (an unknown field or comparison, or missing values), so it never allows and a refusal by it fails closed.
problems.repeated-id: Rule id {rule} is used by more than one rule; each rule needs its own id.
problems.never-decides: Rule {rule} can never decide: rule {other} holds whenever it does and is looked at first.
